title: in-progress configuration
description: Static project, plugin, trusted integration, terminal, server, and notification configuration for in-progress.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference; accepted and ignored at runtime.

host.description: Listen address. Non-loopback values also require IN_PROGRESS_UNSAFE_BIND=1.

allowedOrigins.description: Additional exact browser origins accepted for mutations and WebSocket upgrades.

allowedTailscaleUsers.description: Allowlist for a present Tailscale-User-Login. Empty accepts any present login permitted by tailnet policy; proxy-marked requests without identity are rejected.

pluginDirectories.description: Plugin roots or directories whose immediate children are plugin roots.

integrations.description: Trusted host-side adapters for fixed native tools. Plugin manifests cannot configure executable authority.

sourceDirectory.description: Align checkout containing src/align; relative paths resolve from this config file.

pythonExecutable.description: Existing Python executable used with an isolated -I -B -S bootstrap into the fixed Align source for status and one-shot local initialization.

executable.description: Existing Drift executable; relative paths resolve from this config file.

sourceDirectory.description: Preview checkout containing bin/preview; relative paths resolve from this config file.

artifactDirectory.description: Existing Preview state/output root, disjoint from every configured project; its in-progress-plugin package is installed automatically and ecosystem build initializes its local-only Git history.

codexExecutable.description: Authenticated Codex CLI. Preview requires stored ChatGPT login and strips API credential environment overrides.

sourceDirectory.description: Tree Complete checkout with a built embedded service; relative paths resolve from this config file.

mode.description: Preview writes host-owned simulation state without project/Git mutation; codex requires each project's committed .tree-complete/project.json, creates Git worktrees/branches, and runs unsandboxed Codex after explicit confirmation.

shell.description: Inner zmx session shell executable. Defaults to SHELL, then /bin/sh.

scrollbackBytes.description: Per-session host replay ring size in bytes; zmx separately owns terminal-state restoration.

vapidSubject.description: VAPID contact URI sent to push services.

path.description: Existing project directory; relative paths resolve from the config file.
